markets: See markets.testnet.json - 100 listed, each behind its own TestnetAggregator.
note: Shares the vault's collateral and oracles. The book takes no protocol-side risk: writers post the full maximum payout and keep the premium, buyers escrow their premium behind a resting bid, and the protocol keeps only the fee. Anyone can list a market via listMarketPermissionless; those are flagged verified=false because the contract cannot judge whether an oracle is honest.
